fields.label: FAQs (question followed by answer)
fields.current:
How does picking work?
Choose a cell to pick a Pokémon for that type and generation. Then choose your favorites from each row and column, and an overall favorite.

Can I export the chart?
Yes. Save the Full grid or Simplified view as a PNG. You can filter Pokémon by your favorites in the Pokédex and gym leader builders.
fields.proposed:
How do I make a favorite Pokémon chart by type and generation?
Choose a Pokémon for each type and generation cell. Then pick your favorites from each row and column, including an overall favorite.

Can I export a chart of my favorite Pokémon of each type?
Yes. Export the Full grid, or choose Simplified for your type, generation, starter, legendary, gimmick, and overall favorites. Both save as PNGs.

Is it free? Do I need an app or an account?
Free, in the browser, no sign-up, no download. Your choices save in this browser. Clearing browser data can remove them, so export a PNG to keep your chart.

Can I choose alternate forms or shiny Pokémon?
The picker includes alternate forms, including regional forms and Mega Evolutions. It uses non-shiny pixel-art sprites. Available choices depend on the cell's type and generation.

Can I use my favorites in the other my151 tools?
Yes. The Pokédex builder and gym leader maker can filter their Pokémon lists to your saved favorites in this browser.
